display_preferences: Prefer the approved in-chat meal recommendation card style.
Use meal_plan.plan.v1 when breakfast, lunch, dinner, and nutrition notes are all present.
Use meal_plan.overview.v1 when the user asks for a concise overview.
Use meal_plan.timeline.v1 when the user asks about meal timing or sequence.
Use meal_plan.dashboard.v1 when the user asks about calories, nutrients, or ratios.
